#!name=Soul

[MITM]
hostname = 47.110.187.87, ssp.soulapp.cn, chat-live.soulapp.cn, api-chat.soulapp.cn, api-account.soulapp.cn, api-global.soulapp.me, api-a.soulapp.cn, api-pay.soulapp.cn, gateway-mobile-gray.soulapp.cn, post.soulapp.cn, api-user.soulapp.cn

[Rewrite]
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/ssp\.soulapp\.cn\/api\/q/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/ssp\.soulapp\.cn\/api\/ad\/config/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/chat-live\.soulapp\.cn\/live\/planet\/recListV2/i then reject(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/api-chat\.soulapp\.cn\/chat\/entrance\/first/i then reject_dict(200)

[Script]
request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/data-collector\.soulapp\.cn\/api\/data\/report\/v\d/i then script("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fmz200/wool_scripts/main/Scripts/template/req_replace_body.js") with enable=${soul_enable}, tag="req_replace_body", timeout=60, requires_body=true
response if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/api-account\.soulapp\.cn\/teenager\/config/i then script("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fmz200/wool_scripts/main/Scripts/soul/soul_ads.js") with enable=${soul_enable}, tag="soul_ads", timeout=60, requires_body=true
